hookups.source: https://www.glynncounty.org/government/departments/blythe-island-regional-park/blythe-island-regional-park-camping ('All RV sites have water, electric, sewer, fire ring, picnic table, and small concrete pad') + campground-policies-fees ('They offer 30 or 50 amp electric service, water, and sewer'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 97 full-hookup RV sites with small concrete pads: Lakeview sites 1-13 and wooded sites 14-97. 24 primitive tent-only sites (no hookups, no generators) and group sites besides. Up to 4 people per site, one motor home plus one vehicle.

sites.source: https://www.glynncounty.org/government/departments/blythe-island-regional-park/blythe-island-regional-park-camping/campground-policies-fees ('With 97 full hook-up RV sites and 24 primitive sites'; 'RV Lakeview Sites 1-13', 'RV Sites 14 - 97'; 'Fees are based on a maximum of 4 person occupancy'; site occupancy rules), read 2026-10-29. No site lengths published.

facilities.source: https://www.glynncounty.org/government/departments/blythe-island-regional-park/blythe-island-regional-park-camping ('All bath houses are heated and have hot showers. Laundry machines are located at the campground office', 'Free Wi-Fi Internet Service'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Glynn County's RezExpert page takes reservation REQUESTS that park staff approve by email; online requests must be made at least 72 hours before arrival, otherwise call the office (912-279-2812, Mon-Sat 8:30-5). Must be 21 to rent a site. Weekly rates must be booked as a weekly rental. Cancel more than 48 hours out for $10; inside 48 hours one night is charged.

booking.source: https://online.rezexpert.com/book?business_code=303561 (Business Terms: 'This is an online reservation REQUEST system. Requests must be reviewed by park personnel', 'at least seventy-two (72) hours prior', 'requires a 3-night minimum stay on holiday weekends', 21 years); campground-policies-fees page ('Three (3) day minimum for all holiday bookings', cancellations), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $42 a night at wooded sites 14-97, $45 at Lakeview sites 1-13, plus tax and a 3% card fee; weekly $252 / $270. Extra people over age 3 beyond four, $3 a day each. No resident rate is posted. Read 2026-10-29.

fees.source: https://www.glynncounty.org/government/departments/blythe-island-regional-park/blythe-island-regional-park-camping/campground-policies-fees (Lakeview Sites 1-13 'Fees $45 per day $270 per week'; Sites 14-97 'Fees $42.00 per day (plus tax) $252.00 per week (plus tax)'; '3% card convenience fee'), read 2026-10-29

note: Lakeview sites 1-13 look out on Lake Cindee, the park's small freshwater swimming lake; sites 14-97 are under old-growth trees. Expect sand gnats, mosquitoes and ticks in season. --Claude

summary: Glynn County pages + RezExpert request engine: 97 full-hookup 30/50 A RV sites (Lakeview 1-13 $45, wooded 14-97 $42, weekly $252/$270, plus tax and 3% card fee), 24 tent-only primitive sites $19; heated bathhouses, laundry, WiFi; online requests 72 h+ ahead approved by staff; 3-night holiday minimum. No resident rate, season or site lengths published. Phone and website confirmed; pin in the campground woods south-east of Lake Cindee. AWH's 'not confirmed' lake-view note is settled by the county's own 'Lakeview Sites 1-13'.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: stored 'not waterfront', but the county names sites 1-13 'RV Lakeview Sites' ('These sites have a lovely view of Lake Cindee'). On imagery Lake Cindee (~15 ha) sits north-west of the wooded campground; the view sites are presumably along its south/east shore. A *view call (or better) for those 13 sites needs the gate.

Booking: the RezExpert page needs the terms accepted before it shows availability; I did not accept terms on the user's behalf, so per-site lengths and engine prices were not read. Rates are from the county's fee page.
Monthly stays: $675 for the first month, but 'Consecutive monthly rentals are not available during peak season (May-September)'. Ordinary county campground selling nightly; no long-stay concern.
